notes: Reference built locally with --allow-unpinned-reference: sha256 differs from the linux-x64 pin (compiler cc 13.3.0 vs the pin's 12.2.0). Tests assert commit 946fcce0 and --disable-x86asm from build-metadata.json and pin no binary digest.
Sandbox Node was v22.23.5; Node 24.22.3 was run from the npm 'node@24' package placed first on PATH.
Baseline before changes: typecheck, lint, boundaries clean; tests/unit/video-operator-registry.test.ts 8/8.

Point stack: native pop order; pushes of non-matching neighbours are skipped, which leaves the set_pixel sequence unchanged because a non-matching pixel never matches later. Indices are 4 bytes; capacity bounded by maxFrameBytes.

Never-terminating fill: native segfaults (exit 139) or spins and ignores SIGTERM; the differential test uses SIGKILL after 2 s and pins only the accepted/refused split (1261/35), not how native fails.
No float paths; no Linux-gated cases. The differential file takes about 13 s with --maxWorkers=1.
Mutations caught by the differential file: dropping the left-neighbour push (5/7 failed), matching only plane 0 (5/7 failed).
